thread:
alex: Deploy-bot flagged a transitive vuln in metrics-lib v2.1.8 during the RC canary. deploy-bot: [scan] severity: MEDIUM, CVE-2025-9999, path: metrics->http-client->old-crypto (transitive). details: https://scans.internal/1715001234 :warning:
maria: thanks for the ping. is this reachable from customer data plane or only internal telemetry?
joel: only used by our metrics ingestion path, not in the inference path. no PII, but used in EU canary.
sophie: TL;DR: risk is code-exec in native module if network attacker supplies crafted response. we have no known exploit right now.
alex: OK — options: 1) pin transitive to patched digest (if available) and rebuild, 2) hotpatch by adding runtime mitigation (strong validation), 3) carve out EU canary (delay EU rollout) and proceed global, 4) full rollback.
maria: legal & compliance: EU carveout requires customer notice for HIPAA/regulated customers? legal: ping.
legal: if it's not customer-data-exposed and only telemetry, we can carve out EU for now but must update release notes + internal risk queue and inform enterprise customers in affected regions.
joel: how long to pin+build+verify? estimate ~3 hours to change dependency pin, CI + canary run ~45m.
sophie: hotpatch option is ~1.5 hours but riskier — need extra tests. pin is safer.
alex: change window is 2pm UTC. if we aim for pin, need approval now. maria, can security approve an expedited pin?
maria: Approve pin + staged EU carveout as fallback. Conditions: must run full vuln scan after build, include SBOM diff in release artifacts, and legal sign-off on customer communications. :white_check_mark:
joel: I'll open a quick PR to pin to http-client@sha256:abcd1234 and trigger CI. PR: https://git.internal/r/9876
deploy-bot: PR 9876 opened by joel, CI started. status: running.
alex: if CI passes, we merge and do EU canary only if post-scan clean; otherwise keep carveout and do global later. Also add a release-note entry: "Metrics ingestion dependency pinned to mitigate CVE-2025-9999; EU rollout limited pending final audit."
maria: don't forget to attach SBOM and signed attestations.
joel: CI green. post-build vuln scan shows vulnerability no longer present in transitive path. scan report: https://scans.internal/1715001234/report.html
sophie: verified SBOM diff, good. mitigation verified in integration tests. I recommend canary resume for non-EU first wave, hold EU until legal confirms messaging.
legal: confirmed. coordinate customer comms with growth ops for enterprise notices.
alex: final decision: pin merged, global rollout proceeds excluding EU. EU carveout scheduled until EOD tomorrow or earlier if final audit clears. recording in release board. :memo:
maria: filing follow-up ticket for hunting any similar transitive deps in other services.
joel: thanks all — I'll monitor deploybot and escalate if rollback needed.
alex: closing thread — will update release notes and notify #release-notes once message drafted. :thumbsup:
